margins.rationale: Both are fixed to the preregistered ±0.025 absolute precision target used to size each primary truth class per split.

criteria: 100% of planned primary series are accounted for as ELIGIBLE_FOR_AFINO or INPUT_INADMISSIBLE
100% of ELIGIBLE_FOR_AFINO primary series have a complete M0/M1/M2 AFINO decision or a prospectively classified execution failure
all primary metric numerators, denominators and Wilson intervals are produced
input inadmissibility is reported separately from classification
period recovery is reported separately from classification
BASELINE_CHARACTERIZATION_SUCCESS.interpretation: Poor baseline sensitivity/specificity is a scientific result, not by itself an execution failure.

CANDIDATE_RULE_DEVELOPMENT_SUCCESS.comparison: candidate vs frozen AFINO baseline on DEVELOPMENT primary eligible series
criteria: 95% paired-bootstrap lower confidence bound of candidate-minus-baseline balanced_accuracy > 0
95% paired-bootstrap lower confidence bound of candidate-minus-baseline sensitivity > -0.025
95% paired-bootstrap lower confidence bound of candidate-minus-baseline specificity > -0.025
complete heldout baseline characterization under the frozen metrics contract
no development retuning after heldout generation

branch_frozen_candidate.comparison: frozen candidate vs frozen AFINO baseline on HELDOUT primary eligible series
criteria: 95% paired-bootstrap lower confidence bound of candidate-minus-baseline balanced_accuracy > 0
95% paired-bootstrap lower confidence bound of candidate-minus-baseline sensitivity > -0.025
95% paired-bootstrap lower confidence bound of candidate-minus-baseline specificity > -0.025
on_failure: no second attempt on the same heldout
any revised candidate requires a new independent validation dataset and new prospective freeze

correction_claim_establishment.allowed_only_if: a candidate passes DEVELOPMENT promotion, is frozen before heldout generation, and passes the single-use HELDOUT candidate branch

scientific_boundaries: baseline characterization success does not imply baseline accuracy is acceptable
development promotion does not establish correction validity
heldout success does not create observational ground truth
classification stability is not evidence of a unique numerical optimum
